key_people.title: 校长（Ректор / Rector）
key_people.title_description: Professor Doctor; appointed Rector of Ala-Too International University in February 2025
key_people.description: Prof. Dr. Nazira Soltonbekovna Esenalieva was appointed Rector in February 2025, succeeding Zhyldyzbek Zhakshylykov. She leads the university through its 30th anniversary celebrations in 2026 and has actively expanded Erasmus+ and international academic cooperation, including a June 2025 visit to Istanbul Medeniyet University.

recent_events.title: 建校30周年暨新品牌形象发布（30th Anniversary and New Corporate Identity Launch）
recent_events.description: AIU celebrated its 30th anniversary by unveiling a new logo and corporate identity symbolizing a new stage of development. The new logo retains the Ala-Too mountains (symbolizing strength), the sun (knowledge), and a unifying circle (international academic community). The launch coincided with the 2026 admissions campaign.
recent_events.impact: Marks university's maturation into a leading international institution; 5,000+ students, 500+ international, 300+ faculty, 55+ programs, 140 partner universities in 60 countries, 19 dual degree programs.

recent_events.title: 校长访问伊斯坦布尔文明大学推进Erasmus+合作（Rector visits Istanbul Medeniyet University for Erasmus+ cooperation）
recent_events.description: Rector Prof. Dr. Nazira Esenaliyeva led a delegation to Istanbul Medeniyet University, hosted by Rector Prof. Dr. Gülfettin Çelik. They discussed Erasmus+ KA1/KA2 partnerships, student and academic staff exchange, and scientific cooperation.
recent_events.impact: Strengthened Turkey-Kyrgyzstan academic ties and expanded Erasmus+ credit mobility opportunities for AIU students and faculty.

recent_events.title: 新校长会见Erasmus+国家协调员（New Rector meets Erasmus+ National Coordinator）
recent_events.description: Following her appointment in February 2025, Rector Nazira Esenalieva met the National Erasmus+ Coordinator to discuss the university's Erasmus+ achievements, credit mobility projects, and future international cooperation plans.
recent_events.impact: Affirmed AIU's commitment to internationalization under new leadership; reinforced Erasmus+ projects as a key pillar of academic strategy.

recent_events.title: 土耳其宣布不再承认AIU文凭（Turkey announces non-recognition of AIU diplomas）
recent_events.description: In February 2017, following Kyrgyzstan's refusal to close Gülen-affiliated institutions, the Turkish government announced that diplomas issued by Ala-Too International University would no longer be valid in Turkey. The university had already changed its name from International Ataturk-Alatoo University and appointed a Kyrgyz rector.
recent_events.impact: Strained Turkey-Kyrgyzstan educational relations; accelerated the university's repositioning as a local Kyrgyz institution under the Sapat Educational Foundation.

core_business: Private non-profit international university offering undergraduate, master's, and doctoral programs across four academic faculties (New Technologies, Social Sciences, Economics and Administrative Sciences, Medicine) plus vocational and distance learning centers. English-medium instruction with additional courses in Russian, Kyrgyz, and Turkish. Hosts 5,000+ students including ~500 international from 20+ countries, with strong MBBS/medical programs attracting students from India, Pakistan, and Nepal.
apec_stance: While not an APEC-specific institution, AIU is a strongly internationalized English-medium university positioned as a 'Gateway to the World' with 140+ partner universities in 60 countries. It actively participates in Erasmus+ programs with European and Turkish partners, hosts faculty from the USA and India, and attracts medical students from across Asia. Its English-language curriculum and international partnerships make it a regional educational hub bridging Central Asia with Turkey, Europe, and South Asia. The university maintains strong internationalization despite the 2016-2017 diplomatic strain with Turkey over its Gülen-movement origins.
